topScam.title: The WhatsApp Part-Time "Hotel Review / Like" Job
topScam.scam: You get a WhatsApp message offering ₹2,000–₹5,000 per day to like YouTube videos or review hotels. You complete initial tasks and receive ₹300 genuine payout to build trust. Then you are added to a Telegram VIP group and convinced to deposit ₹50,000 to "unlock" higher commissions, which you can never withdraw.
topScam.protection: Legitimate businesses never recruit over WhatsApp to pay for video likes. Any scheme paying small token amounts upfront to lure you into depositing larger "prepaid" funds is a scam.

realityPick.title: The "Build vs Buy" Enterprise AI Platform Money Pit
realityPick.myth: We need to build our own in-house custom LLM orchestration platform from scratch to maintain proprietary competitive advantage.
realityPick.reality: Internal platform builds take 9–14 months and consume $1.5M+ in engineering payroll, only to be rendered obsolete every quarter as open standards (Model Context Protocol, Ollama, Langflow, Dify) and cloud provider primitives leapfrog internal codebases.
realityPick.fix: Standardize on open protocols (MCP) and swappable gateway layers. Treat LLMs and orchestrators as commodity utilities; build your proprietary moat strictly around domain-specific enterprise data, private business logic, and custom evaluation benchmarks.
realityPick.impact: Millions wasted in custom platform development while competitors deploy standard MCP architectures in days.
